summary: Quince Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing the abrupt, pre-announced departures of CEO/CMO Dirk Thye, M.D. (also a director) and COO/CBO/CCO Brendan Hannah, effective October 8, 2026. The board appointed Brigette Roberts, M.D., previously Chief Corporate Affairs Officer and a director since May 2026, as CEO effective the same date. The filing also covers a name change to IRulya Therapeutics Inc. effective 4:01 p.m. ET on October 9, 2026, together with bylaw amendments and Regulation FD disclosure. No deal economics were stated; watch for leadership transition execution and any strategic repositioning under the new name.
